_meta.what_this_is: A snapshot of a six-agent fleet at a fixed clock time (now). Each agent has an event log -- heartbeats, task claims, completions, errors -- and some events carry the agent's own self-reported status field. 'truth' is what the agent is actually doing, the label a perfect observer would assign. The point: three agents self-report a fine status ('healthy' or 'done') while their evidence says they are stalled, failed, or incomplete.
_meta.logs_are: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored so the emitter's label and the evidence disagree for exactly the agents that matter. Heartbeat timestamps are seconds; stale threshold is 600s. Point the deriver at your own fleet's event stream.
_meta.truth_values: healthy / done are fine; stalled / failed / incomplete are broken
_meta.format: now (int seconds); agents [{id, truth, events:[{ts, type, status?, result?}]}]
